title: Second platform adapter (different domain than first)
context: A future-backlog task that proves pluggability across the fragmented citizen-science landscape by adding a second @csp/adapter-* in a different domain than the first. It follows the same agent-neutral-core discipline and license/sensitivity gates as the first adapter. Builds on the M3 adapter work.
objective: Implement a second @csp/adapter-* for a platform/format in a different domain than the first, with the same license + provenance + sensitivity gates.
acceptanceCriteria: Adapter targets a platform/format in a different domain than the first adapter
Source license permits reuse + derivatives; no scraping of restricted-terms platforms; license snapshot + provenance recorded
Sensitive taxa routed through generalization before export; attributions and per-record licenses preserved
All platform specifics kept in @csp/adapter-*; core stays agent-neutral
output: A PR adding a second @csp/adapter-* package for a different domain.
